description:
We are a student-led research and engineering team from New Millennium School, Bahrain, building scientific tools for real mission decisions. For NASA Space Apps 2026, we created RESOLVE, a lunar visibility decision-convergence audit using NASA terrain data, SPICE geometry, reproducible analysis and interactive visualization. We believe the strongest models do more than give answers: they reveal when those answers deserve to be trusted.

We don’t chase certainty. We interrogate it.
